caption:
Meta's Muse AI agent passed 10 million US downloads in its first 40 days, Sensor Tower estimates.
ChatGPT needed 123 days to hit the same mark, Grok 211 and Claude 673.
But Meta is pouring 39% of its October ad budget into Muse, and many users drop off after two weeks.

Have you tried Muse yet, or are you sticking with ChatGPT?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: Sensor Tower via PPC Land · Photo: Meta

slides.headline: Meta's Muse just hit *10 million US downloads* in 40 days. ChatGPT needed 123

slides.heading: Faster than *ChatGPT, Grok and Claude*
paras: Muse passed 10 million US downloads in 40 days, Sensor Tower estimates. Only 11 other apps have done that since 2015, the last one being Threads.
ChatGPT took 123 days to reach that mark. Grok took 211, Claude 673.

slides.heading: Meta's *ad machine* is behind it
paras: Meta put 39% of its October ad spend into Muse, up from 23% in September, Sensor Tower says. Muse jumped from 73rd to 21st in US ad impressions.
It reached 2.5 million daily users on October 16.
slides.note: Meta's headquarters in Menlo Park, California.

slides.heading: The catch: *people drop off*
paras: 73% of September users came back the next day, but only 23% after two weeks. Sensor Tower calls its numbers estimates.

paras.t: Meta also paused chat sharing after researchers found about 6,800 exposed chats.

slides.hook: Meta is betting big on Muse. Follow to see if users stay once the ad push slows down.
